data.title: Grayscale’s Pandl still sees bitcoin’s $58K low as the bottom, gives clients ‘green light’
data.summary_raw: Grayscale's Zach Pandl maintains bitcoin bottomed near $58,000 as the firm gives clients a "green light" to allocate.

data.title: Bitwise CIO Hougan revises Clarity Act outlook, says crypto bull market may continue without legislation
data.summary_raw: Bitcoin climbed above $80,000 in early September despite declining odds of the legislation passing this year, Hougan noted.

data.title: South Korean police charge 26 Polymarket users for illegal gambling: report
data.summary_raw: The country blocked local access to Polymarket last month after its media regulator ruled that the platform offers illegal gambling.

data.title: ‘Not the end’: Sen. Gillibrand says Democrats still committed to passing Clarity Act
data.summary_raw: Industry analysts say it is highly unlikely for the bill to pass this Congress, and instead pointed to the SEC and CFTC's rulemaking efforts.
